name: Sakurazaki Kotoko
source: A third-year student who is also the student council president. On the surface she seems like a perfect person - she is talented at both studying and sports, is admired by everyone, and is completely trusted by the teachers as well. However in reality, she has exhibitionististic tendencies and cannot control them, despite always doing her best to hide them from everyone else; as a result, she sometimes doesn't wear panties.
